presentation.label: NOTE OCTAVE
presentation.summary: FUNC + turn on a trig's note moves it by an octave, on audio and MIDI tracks.
presentation.overview: On the TRIG page, FUNC + turn on a note moves it twelve semitones a detent instead of stock's jump. It covers the audio track's NOTE and the MIDI track's NOT1 to NOT4, moves the track's note or, with a trig held, that step's lock, and makes no octave that would leave the note's range.
highlights: An octave every three detents, up or down, at FUNC + LEN's pace.
The track's note, or a held trig's lock.
No clamp at the edge: the note never changes, only its octave.
usage: Select an audio track and press TRIG.
Hold FUNC and turn A three detents to the left: NOTE goes to -12.
Hold a trig key as well to move that step's note lock instead.
On a MIDI track, do the same on NOT1, or B to D for the chord notes.

access.location: TRIG page, note knobs, with FUNC held
steps: Open TRIG on an audio or MIDI track.
Hold FUNC and turn the note knob (A, or B to D for a MIDI track's chord notes).

controls.name: FUNC + A (NOTE, NOT1)
controls.doc: Moves the note an octave every three detents.

controls.name: FUNC + B-D (NOT2-NOT4)
controls.doc: Moves a MIDI chord note an octave every three detents.

limitations: At most one octave an encoder message: a very fast spin moves a little less.

load.conditions: The module patches only the TRIG page's knob handler and runs on encoder events; it subscribes to no core events and adds no work to the audio block.

hardware.summary: draadpiraat ran NO03 (an octave a detent) on their Digitakt I, OS 1.54, found it worked but too fast, then NO08 (an octave every three detents, this release): "note octave seems good, publish it."
limitations: Held-trig locks, MIDI chord notes and the range edge were not reported one by one.

tests.summary: On a unit: the owner's Digitakt I, OS 1.54, NO08 (this build) good, after NO03 worked but was too fast. Emulator: an octave every three detents on audio NOTE and MIDI NOT1/NOT2, refused at the range edge, other knobs keep stock's jump.
